annotation.summary: Two different groups meet over an unexpectedly shared interest.
annotation.visual: Two muscular arms clasp hands in the center of the frame, leaving room to label each arm and their shared connection.
annotation.mechanism: The contrast between the groups makes their common preference, habit, or enemy amusing.
scenarios: Frontend and backend developers both hate last-minute changes
People with opposing tastes agree about one snack
Rival teams share the same complaint about management

examples.why: Groups that often disagree unite over a familiar complaint.

avoid: The center label should be a genuine common point between the two side labels.
annotation.basis: Creative interpretation based on inspected source media; not a verified account of historical origin.
